> ECL AI Components — Plain-text agent protocol
> Free to browse and download. Component markup and metadata are original works; ecl-* class names used under ECL terms (EUPL).
> Home: https://github.com/ednark/ecl-ai-components
> Base layer: https://github.com/ednark/ai-component-registry-spec (submodule at _base/)

---

## Overview

Europa Component Library registry for AI coding agents building European Commission and EU institutional websites. 29 self-contained component tiles across 24 component families with categorized adaptation, coordination, and compliance metadata (EN 301 549, WCAG 2.1 AA, Directive (EU) 2016/2102). EC-branded; EU variant derivable. Localised into 24 EU languages — language selection is a site-header concern.

## Machine manifest

> https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ednark/ecl-ai-components/main/agents.json

---

## Quick start

1. Filter vocab: GET https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ednark/ecl-ai-components/main/infinite/facets.json
2. Discovery index (lean): GET https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ednark/ecl-ai-components/main/infinite/components.index.json
3. Component source: GET https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ednark/ecl-ai-components/main/infinite/{file}
4. Recipes: GET https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ednark/ecl-ai-components/main/infinite/recipes/index.json
   (contact-form, confirmation-page, search-results, content-page, news-listing)
5. Version history: GET https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ednark/ecl-ai-components/main/infinite/versions.json

---

## Facets

- eclComponentType — button, text-input, select, notification, table, card, tag, etc.
- section — forms, navigation, feedback, data-display
- variant — component variant
- requiresJs — no, optional, required
- interaction — passive, click, focus, keyboard, type, change
- govCompliance — EN 301 549, WCAG 2.1 AA, Directive (UE) 2016/2102
- a11y — wcag21AA, keyboardNav, screenReader, reducedMotion, forcedColors, ariaAttributes
- costTier — cheap, moderate, expensive
- prerequisites — components to fetch first (ecl-form-group before fields)
- compositionRecipes — recipes this component participates in
- piiHandling — accepts_input, displays_only, none
- touchTargetSize — 44px on interactive components
- supportedTokenProfiles — highContrast

---

## ECL rules

- Every field sits inside an ecl-form-group — fetch form-group first
- Errors use ecl-feedback-message in the group — no page-level error summary
- Buttons keep the ecl-button__container > ecl-button__label structure
- Identity assets (EC/EU logo) follow Commission identity rules
- 24 EU languages: keep text externalisable

---



## Decision strategy

1. Understand the requested outcome: what must the interface accomplish?
2. Infer the interface type: single component, section, or full page
3. Check declared gaps (registry.config.json) before searching — use each gap's nearestAlternative
4. Search the index, filtering by facets
5. Prefer existing components over generating new UI from scratch
6. Prefer `costTier: "cheap"` and `requiresJs: "no"` unless the task requires otherwise
7. Respect the registry mandates (see Quality gates)
8. Only generate new UI if no suitable component exists

---
## Quality gates and declared gaps

Do not retrieve or deploy a component that:

- Has `costTier: "expensive"` unless the task explicitly requires the richer behavior — avoid for mobile-primary or static contexts
- Has `requiresJs: "required"` when the delivery context has no JavaScript
- Whose `constraints.knownLimitations` block the delivery context
- Implements a concept declared in `gaps` (registry.config.json) — use the gap's nearestAlternative instead; never invent a component-style class for it
- Needs layout or typography classes outside the tiles — use `core-classes.json` (the documented untiled layer), never invented component classes

Registry mandates that act as gates:

- Content is localised into 24 EU languages — language selection lives in the site header
- Check `govCompliance` (EN 301 549 / WCAG 2.1 AA / Directive (EU) 2016/2102)
- EU emblem and EC logo are governed identity assets — never restyle

Declared gaps: see `gaps` in registry.config.json. Untiled layout/typography layer: see `infinite/core-classes.json`.

---

## Output contract

1. Reason — why this component over alternatives
2. Selected components — file paths and titles
3. ECL classes needed — exact ecl-* class names
4. Constraint verification — preserve elements intact
5. Remaining work — what the component does not cover
6. Recommended next — what to retrieve next
